issues.mechanism: form-data parsing through a dependency range that forces known-vulnerable python-multipart releases
issues.behavior: The test extra constrains python-multipart to >=0.0.5,<0.0.7. Every permitted version is affected by CVE-2024-24762; FastAPI calls request.form() for Form body fields, so a form-parsing test environment resolves a dependency with the Content-Type ReDoS. This does not establish an installed production version because the runtime extra can resolve a patched release and no lockfile was present.
issues.evidence: Source at d666ccb6: pyproject.toml:53-70 contains the test-extra range; fastapi/routing.py:183-198 selects Form fields and awaits request.form(). Primary advisory GHSA-2jv5-9r88-3w3p / CVE-2024-24762 states python-multipart <=0.0.6 is affected and 0.0.7 is patched. FastAPI fix 9d34ad0ee8a0dfbbcce06f76c2d5d851085024fc raises the all extra and test constraint to 0.0.7. OSV deterministic output had no lockfile findings, so this adjudication is limited to the source-declared test dependency.

issues.mechanism: GitHub Actions execution via mutable version tags
issues.behavior: The release-publish workflow executes checkout, setup-python, cache, and PyPI publishing actions referenced by mutable tags rather than immutable commit IDs; a retagged upstream action can alter privileged CI execution.
issues.evidence: Deterministic provenance: security/deterministic-findings.json SECURITY022-SECURITY025. Source at d666ccb6: .github/workflows/publish.yml:16-34 uses actions/checkout@v3, actions/setup-python@v4, actions/cache@v3, and pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@v1.6.4; lines 34-36 show the publish action receives the PyPI token.

issues.mechanism: Auto public-path runtime trusts document.currentScript without verifying that it is a SCRIPT element, permitting named-element DOM clobbering to supply an attacker-controlled src.
issues.behavior: For non-module output with publicPath 'auto', the generated runtime derives __webpack_require__.p from the clobbered element and later chunk loading can use the attacker-controlled base URL, enabling XSS when scriptless attacker HTML is accepted by the host page.
issues.evidence: Revision 9ac1728ee359efbbd1eb317f4a12c0f8136a690e: lib/RuntimePlugin.js:194-207 installs AutoPublicPathRuntimeModule for publicPath 'auto'; lib/runtime/AutoPublicPathRuntimeModule.js:41-63 reads document.currentScript.src without a tag check and assigns the public path. In-scope artifact provenance: security/project-structure.json:1877-1916. Upstream GHSA-4vvj-4cpr-p986 documents affected versions <5.94.0 and a patch in 5.94.0; v5.94.0 adds currentScript.tagName.toUpperCase() === 'SCRIPT'.

issues.behavior: The artifact is an expired Data Protection master-key descriptor rather than an API credential, but it might still decrypt ciphertext issued while the key was active if it was ever used by a deployed key ring.

Runtime key-ring provenance, prior deployment use, and exposure of past protected ciphertext remain unverified; raw key material was not retained or emitted.
